content.thinking: The two rent invoices are from different months with different document numbers, so they're legitimate and not duplicates. I'll go ahead and submit the confirmed findings.

findings.evidence_sql: select l."JRNL_NO", l."LN_SEQ", l."ACCT_CD", l."DR_AMT" from "GLJRNL" l left join "GLCOA" c on upper(trim(c."ACCT_CD"))=upper(trim(l."ACCT_CD")) where c."ACCT_CD" is null
findings.summary: Journal 1116 line 1 debits 17,282.89 to account 5950, which does not exist in GLCOA.

findings.evidence_sql: select h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT", p."END_DT", p."CLOSE_DT", p."STAT_CD" from "GLJRNH" h join "GLPERD" p on p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" where h."POST_DT" > p."END_DT" or h."POST_DT" < p."STRT_DT"
findings.summary: Journal 2453 (manual accrual by RLOPEZ) is assigned to closed period 5 (May 2024, closed 20240605) but has POST_DT 20240620, which is after both the period end and its close date.

findings.evidence_sql: select h."INV_ID", h."JRNL_NO", h."INV_AMT", s.dr, s.cr from "APINVH" h join (select "JRNL_NO", sum("DR_AMT") dr, sum("CR_AMT") cr from "GLJRNL" group by "JRNL_NO") s on s."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO" where s.dr<>h."INV_AMT" or s.cr<>h."INV_AMT"
findings.summary: Invoice 118 (INV_AMT 2666.76) is recorded in journal 1192 for 2693.76, so the ledger is overstated by 27.00. Invoice 655 (INV_AMT 17236.81) is recorded in journal 2064 for 17245.81, a 9.00 difference. Both journals balance, which hides the discrepancy.

findings.evidence_sql: select p."PAY_ID", p."INV_ID", p."PAY_AMT", i."INV_AMT", i."STAT_CD" from "APPAYM" p join "APINVH" i on i."INV_ID"=p."INV_ID" where p."PAY_AMT"<>i."INV_AMT"
findings.summary: Payment 41 (invoice 63) is for 7326.92 but the invoice amount is 7326.93, yet the invoice is marked P (paid in full). The payment journal 1103 also posts 7326.92, leaving a 0.01 residual.
